titulo.alumno:
«Опрос и общественное мнение»
Surveys and public opinion

intro: In a survey summary, identify the sample, the percentage and which group the data represent.

frases.estudio: В опросе участвовали жители четырёх районов.
frases.alumno: Residents of four districts took part in the survey.

frases.estudio: Половина опрошенных поддержала новый маршрут, но исследование не охватило весь город.
frases.alumno: Half of those surveyed supported the new route, but the study did not cover the whole city.

piezas.titulo: In a survey summary, identify the sample, the percentage and which group the data represent.
texto: In a survey summary, identify the sample, the percentage and which group the data represent.
A result from a sample does not automatically describe the whole population; distinguish the data, the interpretation and the limit.

pregunta.texto: Whom does the result directly represent?

opciones.explicacion: The sample was residents of four districts, not of the whole population.

opciones.texto: all the inhabitants of the country
opciones.explicacion: This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «В опросе участвовали жители четырёх районов.»

frase.texto: В опросе участвовали жители четырёх районов.

opciones.texto: Residents of four districts took part in the survey.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: Half of those surveyed supported the new route, but the study did not cover the whole city.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: Половина опрошенных поддержала новый маршрут, но исследование не охватило весь город

piezas.traduccion: Half of those surveyed supported the new route, but the study did not cover the whole city.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
